entities.summary: Ernesto Antolin Salgado is a Filipino bishop of the Catholic Church who served as the archbishop of Nueva Segovia from 2005 to 2014. Prior to his appointment, he served as the bishop of Laoag and Vicar Apostolic of Baguio and its predecessor Vicariate Apostolic of Mountain Provinces (Montagnosa).
